purpose: Original-triangle whole-footprint rendering; numerical integration on a modern physical NIST phantom, no ink efficacy claim

numerical_rendering.reference16_method: 8x8 quadrature on half-step cells, average each 2x2 cell group with equal UV area
numerical_rendering.reference16_gate: strict RMSE_8 < RMSE_4 < RMSE_1 in each fixed center subset; nonzero RMSE_1 required
numerical_rendering.fixture_selection: Dimension-only formulas in frozen experiment.fixture; no intensity selection, annotations, replacement or adaptive phase
numerical_rendering.reference16_rounding: Same renderer; four half-cell means individually cast to float32 before float64 average and final float32 cast. Not independent implementation or exact once-rounded sum.

decision: All geometry identity, support, per-case RMSE ratio and reference-convergence gates required. This is only a numerical engineering gate, never an ink-detection or reading gate.
failure_policy: Preserve failed run and source receipt, no automatic retry or retuning after CT pixels
source_scope: NIST modern lead-containing-ink physical phantom at nominal130um, not Herculaneum carbon ink; released slices [246,374)
statistics: Deterministic numerical errors on common masks; no inferential p-values or spatial false-positive claim
